llm_generation.text:
Guernica by Pablo Picasso is on display at the Museo Reina Sofía in **Madrid, Spain**.

The painting has been housed there since 1992, after previously being displayed at the Casón del Buen Retiro (also in Madrid). Before returning to Spain in 1981, the painting had been kept at the Museum of Modern Art in New York for decades, in accordance with Picasso's wishes that it not be sent to Spain until democracy was restored following Franco's dictatorship.
